description: Screenshot of the open page in the reply, an ID image beside it (one colour per object, the path with -ids before .png), and a list of what is on screen and the named objects no look has seen, with size and place. It sends no input; sheet, scroll, viewports and compare reload the page for their pictures. One mode a call: cameras, viewports, scroll, sheet, opening, zoom, at, target, save or compare. It ends with the lines the skill's references/lighting.md explains, the `Lighting:` and `Surfaces:` setup faults among them. A post-processed page is pictured as of its last drawn frame, so state set since shows after a step. Use `observe` for the state as numbers, `reference` to read or match a picture the page should look like, and `interact` with `look: true` for the picture after input. Modes in full: references/tools.md.

at.description: Up to 8 points [x, y] in the live page's pixels: the objects drawn at each, nearest first, with distance; text only; from `camera` when given.

camera.description: This look's camera, { position, lookAt }, or a name: a refs/cameras.json picture's file name or a `cameras` label.

cameras.description: Up to 9 cameras ({ position, lookAt, label } or a name) in one grid, no reload; a label is kept as a `camera` name.

compare.description: A saved baseline's name: the page at its frame (a reload), the share of pixels that differ and a diff picture.

game.description: The name the game was opened under with the `open` tool, to act on ("main" by default; a subagent uses its own).

opening.description: Picture the first 5 s after load in real time, as a viewer meets them (`open` pauses at frame 0).

sample.description: Points [x, y] in the live page's pixels (with zoom, inside its box): each one's colour, a 5 × 5 mean.

save.description: Keep this look's picture as the baseline of this name (letters, digits, - or _).

scroll.description: Scroll stops (shares of the page's scroll range) in one grid, each a fresh reload.

sheet.description: Up to 9 moments in one grid, each a fresh reload set with `state`, then `steps` (as `interact`) and `frames`.

target.description: An object in the main scene, alone from front, right, top and three-quarter views.

viewports.description: Sizes in one grid, each a fresh reload: phone (390 × 844, DPR 3), tablet (820 × 1180, 2), laptop (1440 × 900, 2), desktop (1920 × 1080, 1), or [width, height, dpr].

zoom.description: [left, top, right, bottom] in the live page's pixels (not a sheet's), as the plain look lists boxes, enlarged up to 4×; from `camera` when given.

name: look
